0.description: Right. I've rebuilt yer weapon's core usin' the ecliptic arcanite ye procured.

1.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_001
1.description: Now it's time to get slicin'!

3.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_003
3.description: Another resoundin' success. Yer weapon's free from its illusory shroud, an' all them enhancements are completely untouched.

4.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_004
4.description: Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creation: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>!

5.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_005
5.description: Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creations: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> an' <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>!

6.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_006
6.description: As yer well aware, the best is yet to come. Only once yer phantom weapon's filled to the brim with martial memories can we call the bleedin' job done!

7.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_007
7.description: There's enough ecliptic arcanite left over, so I can soon get crackin'. Dodokkuli'll handle the grunt work first, mind.

8.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE4_00979_GEROLT_000_008
8.description: As good as yer phantom weapon feels right now, know that there's plenty more power to wring out o' the thing. Can't leave that potential untapped, can we?
